_comment: Minimal Northwind CdcSinkConfiguration for the W3 Map step of the E2E test. Postgres lowercases unquoted identifiers; the fixture in test/SlowTests/Data/npgsql.northwind.create.sql declares Customer/Product unquoted so their stored names are 'customer' / 'product' with columns 'id' / 'firstname' / 'pic' and 'id' / 'unitprice' / 'isdiscontinued'. Validation requires every primary-key column to also appear in Columns.
Name: wizard-cdc
